data.rationale: Host WS-MKT-0077 generated 63 DNS queries to cdn-metrics-sync.example-analytics.net, a domain registered only 4 days ago and tagged as DGA-like with a suspicious threat intel score of 60. This activity maps to MITRE T1071.004 and T1568.002, indicating potential DNS-based C2 or dynamic resolution. A related alert for low-reputation domain queries on the same host reinforces the pattern of suspicious network behavior.
suggested_actions: Isolate host WS-MKT-0077 (10.20.22.41) pending investigation to prevent potential C2 communication.
Query DNS and proxy logs for WS-MKT-0077 to determine if cdn-metrics-sync.example-analytics.net resolved to an external IP and if any subsequent HTTP/S connections occurred.
Interview user s.novak to verify if the DNS activity corresponds to authorized marketing analytics software or testing.
Run endpoint detection scans on WS-MKT-0077 to identify malware or unauthorized processes associated with the DNS queries.
Block domain cdn-metrics-sync.example-analytics.net at the DNS resolver or firewall level while triage is ongoing.
